title: A briefing deck for any region

steps.say: Start from the header: a parameter, a title that reads it, the logo and slide numbers. The setup chunk computes every number the deck will need.
The number and its trend, side by side: a fitted number in the narrow column, the chart in the wide one.
Two points, one click each, and a note for the presenter that the room never sees.
The method slide: the code first, then on a click the chart it draws, beside it.
A table for the record, then the ask on its own coloured slide: what you want the room to decide.
The done test: render for Tabuk. Title, number, chart and table rebuild from the same data, with nothing copied by hand.

final:
---
title: "Unemployment in `r params$region`"
subtitle: "Briefing · synthetic data"
params:
  region: "Asir"
format:
  revealjs:
    logo: gastat-logo-color.png
    slide-number: true
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tinytable)
rates <- read_csv("unemployment.csv")
area <- rates |> filter(region == params$region)
kingdom <- rates |> filter(region == "Kingdom")
now <- last(area$rate)
change <- now - first(area$rate)
gap <- now - last(kingdom$rate)
```

## The number

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="35%"}
::: {.r-fit-text}
`r scales::number(now, accuracy = 0.1)`%
:::
in 2025 Q4, `r scales::number(change, accuracy = 0.1, style_positive = "plus")`
points since 2022
:::
::: {.column width="65%"}
```{r}
ggplot(area, aes(date, rate)) + geom_line()
```
:::
::::

## Against the Kingdom

::: {.notes}
Ask: what explains the gap?
:::

::: {.incremental}
- Unemployment fell in most regions since 2022
- `r params$region` is `r scales::number(gap, accuracy = 0.1, style_positive = "plus")` points from the Kingdom
:::

## How we know

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| output-location: column-fragment
both <- rates |>
  filter(region %in% c(params$region, "Kingdom"))
ggplot(both, aes(date, rate,
                 colour = region)) +
  geom_line()
```

## The last four quarters

```{r}
area |>
  select(quarter, rate) |>
  slice_tail(n = 4) |>
  tt() |>
  theme_html(portable = TRUE)
```

## The ask {background-color="#4137A8"}

Approve a closer look at `r params$region` next quarter.
